rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for a rehearsal or practice run before a performance.

example.english: We have a rehearsal for the new play tonight, and the performance is tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我哋今晚要排練新劇，聽日就正式演出喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 jiu3 paai4 lin6 san1 kek6 ting1 jat6 zau6 zing3 sik1 jin2 ceot1 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a staged or technical run-through, especially when checking the show before the actual performance.

example.english: Before the opening, we will do a rehearsal to test the lighting and sound.
example.traditional: 開場前我哋先做一次綵排，試埋燈光同音響。
example.jyutping: hoi1 coeng4 cin4 ngo5 dei6 sin1 zou6 jat1 ci3 coi2 paai4 si3 maai4 dang1 gwong1 tung4 jam1 hoeng2

rows.note: Use this figuratively for an event or activity that serves as a preview of something more serious to come.

example.english: This exercise is a rehearsal for the real operation.
example.traditional: 今次演習就係實戰嘅預演。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 jin2 zaap6 zau6 hai6 sat6 zin3 ge3 jyu6 jin2
